entry.title: Resolution 627 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): FC-166: Recommended adoption - 8/4/2026
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN INTERGOVERNMENTAL AGREEMENT WITH THE STATE OF HAWAIʻI, DEPARTMENT OF LAND AND NATURAL RESOURCES, TO RECEIVE A GRANT FOR FOUR ATTENDEES TO PARTICIPATE IN THE NATIONAL ALLIANCE OF PRESERVATION COMMISSIONS FORUM 2026

Allows for the receipt of $20,192 in federally-derived funds to cover travel stipends for two staff members from the Planning Department and two Cultural Resource Commissioners.
